children: U.S. based companies have issued debt amounting to a record 96 billion euros ($107 billion) in the euro credit market so far this year, ING's Timothy Rahill and Marine Leleux say in a note. This surpasses the 92 billion euros of debt issued by U.S. companies in Europe in 2025, the analysts say. Rapid growth in the AI industry has raised financing needs, leading companies to seek funds outside the U.S. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
